summary: Flotek Industries filed an 8-K on August 18, 2026, disclosing the termination of its PREPA Contract for a Puerto Rico power generation project. The company had announced a 10-year agreement on August 3, 2026, expecting $40 million annual revenue and $400 million backlog. Following allegations of procurement irregularities, the Puerto Rico Oversight Board revoked approval and directed PREPA to terminate the contract, referring issues to authorities. The termination stems from a reported unauthorized use of Enchanted Rock's name. No deal terms or price were specified. Watch for potential regulatory actions or disputes regarding the terminated contract.
